description: Mint a prepaid `x402s_...` Bearer session token backed by a $1.00 USDC deposit (Solana or Base) so subsequent tool calls skip per-call signing. Pass optional `ttl_minutes` (range 5-43200; default 43200 = 30 days). Returns `session_token`, `balance_usd`, and `expires_at`. Inspect balance later with get_agent_session_status (sessions auto-expire; no close call needed). Do not use for single read calls (call tools directly). Requires HTTP 402 payment ($1.00 USDC).

payer_address.description: EVM wallet address opening the session (0x...)

ttl_minutes.description: Session lifetime in minutes (default 43200 = 30 days, range 5-43200)
